Semantic label for the command that accepts the current field. Stock renders a two-cell FONT16 image compound ({input_end_prefix} at 0x074E and {input_end_symbol} at 0x074F); it is not ordinary KANJI grid text. The mature English controller hardcodes display cell 0x01F7, so editing this label requires an engine/font-aware replacement rather than silently changing the raster.
